title: pp.dynamics-st~
description: `pp.dynamics-st~` is the stereo version of `pp.dynamics~`, providing compression and expansion with adjustable thresholds, attack/release, makeup gain, dry/wet mix, lookahead, envelope detection, and optional feedback compression. It accepts left and right signals plus stereo sidechain inputs, with control messages on its fifth inlet, and outputs processed left and right signals plus control messages.
